test_sleep_for: test the TimeTest class to verify sleep_for delays execution by the specified quantum duration
test_sleep_until: test the TimeTest class to verify sleep_until waits until the specified absolute time
test_call_in: test the TimeTest class to verify call_in schedules a callback after a delay
test_call_at: test the TimeTest class to verify call_at schedules a callback at an absolute time
test_cancel: test the TimeTest class to verify cancelling a scheduled future prevents the callback from executing
